zh: 修正智能精靈在鍵盤彈出、短螢幕或特大字體下可能出現的 Flutter 黑黃溢出警告紋理，問卷內容改為可滾動並保留安全的底部導航區。
重新設計主題強調色與海報配色：所有品牌色、主結果文字與成就橫幅會依背景自動校正對比度，並改善琥珀等淺色主題的可讀性。
設定頁的強調色由無文字色點改為「深青／靛藍／玫紅／琥珀／海藍／紫羅蘭」具名選項，降低選色理解成本。
指數定投新增每日、每週、每兩週及每月四種頻率；每日按約 250 個交易日／年估算，結果同步顯示每次投入、每年約投入、累計本金、收益及收益率。
智能精靈同步支援定投頻率選擇，跨平台 JSON 計算接口亦可傳入 frequency/contribution。
優化手機首頁響應式佈局，窄屏優先單欄卡片，避免兩欄卡片過窄、文字難讀。
強化 AA 分賬窄屏佈局及 BMI/熱量活動量下拉框，避免極窄或大字體環境的文字溢出。
新增 WCAG 對比度回歸測試、定投頻率守恆測試，以及首頁＋20 個計算器＋設定＋智能精靈的短屏／特大字／深色模式 UI 壓力測試。
新增可重跑的 Flutter Web 真實交互巡檢腳本，逐頁打開 20 個計算器並驗證智能精靈完整結果與分享海報流程。
en: Fixed Smart Wizard RenderFlex overflow stripes that could appear with the keyboard, short screens, or extra-large text by making question content scrollable and keeping navigation in a safe bottom area.
Redesigned theme and poster contrast handling: brand colors, key result text, and achievement banners now adjust automatically against their backgrounds, including light amber-style themes.
Replaced unlabeled accent-color dots with named Teal, Indigo, Rose, Amber, Blue, and Violet choices in Settings.

Added daily, weekly, biweekly, and monthly DCA frequencies. Daily DCA uses about 250 trading days per year, and results now show per-contribution amount, approximate yearly contribution, principal, profit, and return rate.
Added DCA frequency selection to Smart Wizard and frequency/contribution support to the cross-platform JSON calculation API.
Improved responsive mobile home layout so narrow screens use readable single-column cards instead of cramped two-column cards.
Hardened AA split rows and the BMI/activity selector against narrow-screen and large-text overflows.
Added WCAG contrast regression tests, DCA frequency conservation tests, and UI stress tests covering Home + 20 calculators + Settings + Smart Wizard on short screens, large text, and dark mode.
Added a repeatable Flutter Web interaction smoke tester that opens all 20 calculators and verifies the complete Smart Wizard result/share-poster flow.
